name: Overhead Surface Orientation
description: Surface orientation penalty: overhead/ceiling work runs ~20% slower than wall work due to overhead viewing angle, gravity working against the painter, and reach mechanics. Equivalent to multiplying production rate by 0.8 (e.g., wall 1000 SF/hr → ceiling 800 SF/hr). Stored as a TIME multiplier per engine convention (≥1 = slower). FORWARD-LOOKING DECLARATION: engine wiring (db.factor_modifiers rows + ctx.surface_orientation population in context-adapter.js) is a follow-up. Until wiring lands, modules using this modifier carry a temporary `rate_per_hour` override on the affected task_ref entries, marked with `_band_aid: "BA_FAC_OVERHEAD"` for grep-based reversion.
